def even_bit_toggle_number(n):
    """Write a python function to toggle all even bits of a given number.

    Bits are counted from 1, starting with the least significant bit,
    so the even bits are the zero-based bit positions 1, 3, 5, ...
    Only bits up to the most significant set bit are toggled, e.g.
    10 (``0b1010``) becomes 0.
    """
    mask = 0
    for position in range(1, n.bit_length(), 2):
        mask |= 1 << position
    return n ^ mask
